related.title: Redis sorted set：排行榜、同分與區間
related.titleEn: Redis sorted sets: leaderboards,ties and ranges
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：追蹤資料庫更新與 cache miss 填入交錯，辨識 stale fill。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Trace interleaved database updates and cache misses to identify stale fills. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 以唯一 member 與 score 建排行，確認更新分數不會新增第二筆同 member。
related.differenceEn: Build a leaderboard of unique members and scores and verify updating one member does not duplicate it.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: TTL 限制保留時間但不是強一致保證；舊讀者可能在新寫者失效 cache 後再填入舊值。 教學基準：5+60 = 65 stale entry expiry time；第二檢核：65-5 = 60 possible stale retention seconds。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Sorted set 的 member 唯一而 score 可相同；同分次序遵循系統定義，需與產品排名政策分開。 教學基準：90+15 = 105 B updated score；第二檢核：4 = 4 unique members。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TTL bounds retention rather than guaranteeing strong consistency; an old reader may refill stale data after invalidation. Teaching baseline: 5+60 = 65 stale entry expiry time; second check: 65-5 = 60 possible stale retention seconds. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Members are unique while scores may tie; system tie ordering is distinct from product ranking policy. Teaching baseline: 90+15 = 105 B updated score; second check: 4 = 4 unique members. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Apache Arrow：validity bitmap 與欄式緩衝
related.titleEn: Apache Arrow: validity bitmaps and columnar buffers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：追蹤資料庫更新與 cache miss 填入交錯，辨識 stale fill。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Trace interleaved database updates and cache misses to identify stale fills. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 手工建立含 NULL 的 int32 欄，區分值緩衝與 validity bitmap。
related.differenceEn: Build an int32 column with NULLs and distinguish value buffers from validity bitmaps.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: TTL 限制保留時間但不是強一致保證；舊讀者可能在新寫者失效 cache 後再填入舊值。 教學基準：5+60 = 65 stale entry expiry time；第二檢核：65-5 = 60 possible stale retention seconds。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
NULL 的實際值槽內容不能當有效值；bit 表示 validity，切片另有 offset，alignment 可能增加配置大小。 教學基準：10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes；第二檢核：ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TTL bounds retention rather than guaranteeing strong consistency; an old reader may refill stale data after invalidation. Teaching baseline: 5+60 = 65 stale entry expiry time; second check: 65-5 = 60 possible stale retention seconds. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

The stored payload of a NULL slot is not a valid value; validity bits,offsets and allocation alignment are separate. Teaching baseline: 10*4 = 40 value-buffer bytes; second check: ceil(10/8) = 2 validity bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
